elements.title: Screenshot of a 13-term Excel Window SMA (Used with permission from Microsoft)
elements.details: Excel spreadsheet screenshot showing columns Month (A) and Value (B) with dates from 1/1/2016 to 1/1/2017 and corresponding numeric values. Cell C8 contains the formula =AVERAGE(B2:B14). The range B2:B14 is highlighted.
elements.summary: This screenshot illustrates how to calculate a 13-term Simple Moving Average (SMA) in Excel by using the AVERAGE function over a selected range of values.

elements.details: Excel spreadsheet screenshot showing columns Month (A), Value (B), and SMA (C). Dates range from 1/1/2016 to 6/1/2017. Column C contains SMA values starting from row 8, e.g., 56987 at 7/1/2016, 55910.2 at 8/1/2016, 55781.29 at 9/1/2016, continuing downward.
elements.summary: This screenshot shows the result of dragging the SMA formula down column C to create a time series of 13-term SMA values corresponding to the original data in column B.
